title: Cheapest Way to Purchase a Sony PlayStation 5 Disc/Blu-Ray Edition
body:
Need some advice on how to buy a new PlayStation 5 disc edition as cheap as possible. I'm aware of the shortages and the lack of recent deals. I'm also aware that with GTA VI coming out in a few months, there most likely won't be a good deal.
But I'd like to see what methods the pros of OzBargain use to save money on a hefty purchase like this one.
